structured.answer: Psagot Trade looks fine: no monthly account fee (0.00 ₪), 0.07% per buy/sell with a 2 ₪ minimum, 0.03% a quarter for holding, you need 10,000 ₪ to open, and you can buy קרן סל and קרנות נאמנות. But their ads promise no conversion fee and no fee on funds, and the documents say otherwise.
